ruleDefinitions.name: MSSQL SPProcoption Set
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when the a stored procedure is set or cleared for automatic execution in MSSQL. A stored procedure that is set to automatic execution runs every time an instance of SQL Server is started Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = RGX(".*MSSQL.*") AND event_id = 33205 AND (Data = RGX(".*object\\_name\\:sp\\_procoption.*") AND Data = RGX(".*statement\\:EXEC.*")))
